snapshot.title: Apply discovery bonus to mission payout in debrief
snapshot.description: RocketsManager.mark_discovery_bonus_claimed() and is_discovery_bonus_claimed() exist, but MissionDebrief._calc_payout() never uses them. Economy doc specifies 10% bonus for visiting a new/unconfirmed target for the first time. Bonus should stack on top of route multiplier and location bonus.

acceptanceCriteria.text: First visit to any target applies a 10% discovery bonus to gross payout
Subsequent visits to same target get no discovery bonus
Debrief shows 'Discovery Bonus +10%' line when bonus applied
Bonus is marked claimed on first sell so repeat visits get no bonus
